## 2024-10-19 - Enable copy button for Gradio Textbox
**Learning:** Textboxes containing lengthy output, logs, or URLs generated by the app should natively support a copy-to-clipboard functionality to improve user efficiency and save them from manual text highlighting which can be cumbersome and error-prone.
**Action:** Added `show_copy_button=True` parameter to `gr.Textbox` components like `auth_url_output`, `output` and `plan_preview` in Gradio interface.
